notes.title: Update time! - Version 1.2.0.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I managed to push out that build I was talking about a few weeks back, apologies on it taking so long. I've stretched myself out quite a bit trying to get a bunch of things ready + work took up a lot of time. Anyways!

- There's now a checkpoint system in Area 4-2. Basically you hit the checkpoint, and when you die you can respawn there. This removes your ability to get a star, but you can revert that by restarting the level.

- There's now a star indicator on the World Select Screen. This includes each areas Warp Zones, so this should help with those trying to 100% the game.

- Fixed a bug where certain characters weren't having their correct icon appear on the 1up power-up. 

- General optimizations and what not. The lasers now take a lot less CPU so if you were having issues there it should be much better now.

- Steam overlay should be working properly now. Let me know if it isn't working, and I'll do what I can.

- A bunny head is now available, leaves an egg trail and everything. Yes I realize I missed easter by like a week but I dun care.

I think that's it, there were a lot of optimizations and such but nothing noticeable. Trading cards *should* be done soon so hopefully that'll be ready for you guys soon.

Have a great week and thanks for playing!

notes.title: Minor update - Version 1.013
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, did a little patch to the previous update, nothing major but fixes a few potential issues.


- Corrected an issue that would cause the game to think it was beaten even after a reset, preventing the ending sequence from playing in the same session.

- Corrected a potential issue where it was possible to use frame skips to pass through a breakable barrier without a second dash.

- Removed the gate that appeared after you hit chip's final button, which prevented you from getting the head that was up there. After reviewing why I put it there, it was kind of a dick move.

- Changed up a bit of World 3 boss' cut scene area, hopefully preventing people from being able to escape the gated area.


Another update should be hitting soon, I still want to add one handed controls and what not, will keep you all up to date. 

Thanks for being awesome!

notes.title: Update - Version 1.011
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! After receiving some feedback there's been an update applied this morning. Here are a list of the more relevant changes:

- The warp pieces you have collected / missed now appear over the levels they are located in.

- The font for the warp piece indicator changes to "WARP" once you've collected all three needed for the area.

- The warp piece / selection box in the world select screen now changes to a star if you've aced it.

- Restart / Context menu for gamepad has been changed to 'Y' to prevent confusion with the start button.

- There is now a quick restart quick key --> "R" for keyboard and "Y" for gamepads. 

- Area 2-2-5 "Precision" has been toned down slightly.

- Area 4-9-9 "Gauntlet IX" has had one section made less...unfair.

Anyways let me know what you think and if you find any more bugs!


QUICK NOTE: If you find there are any issues you can revert back to the old version by going to Steam --> Game Properties --> Betas --> previous_version

- Fixed an issue with a head causing an effect (it's a secret, but it's fixed)

This is being posted 1 hour before release time. Tell you friends, tell your family, tell your communities! Also, have a great day, maybe go for a walk.

Cheers,
Reece

notes.title: Pre-Release Build v0.9.9.0
notes.notes:
Heyo!

So, this *should* be the final build before release on Tuesday. Most of it is minor changes, and I may have forgotten a few, but here is what I do remember changing:

- Fixed a small text error if the player were to die directly after starting a level (and I mean directly, like less than half a second).
- Fixed an issue with the magnetic platforms, which caused a downwards dash to have a shortened jump afterwards.
- Fixed an issue with Warp 8 not always completing. 
- Lowered the requirements for two achievements: "Speedster Award" and "Retry Award"
- Fixed some issues caused by one of the secret heads.

Two days until launch! Be sure to check out my twitter page for any special announcements / giveaways (there will be some for sure) that are happening this week: http://twitter.com/blekdar

Cheers!
Reece

notes.title: Pre-Release Build v0.9.2.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

For anyone playing the current pre-release build, after receiving some feedback,  a new update was pushed out last night. 

List of important changes:

- When running in window mode, the game now scales at integers (1x, 2x, 3x, 4x) to avoid funny looking pixels/text/etc. The window now also has a minimum size at 1x, and won't scale below that, for the same reasons.
- The keyboard controls for movement are now inline with the gamepad controls. You can 'prep' your next dash by pressing the desired direction before colliding with a wall, which allows you to dash at the first possible frame. 
- The following levels have been tweaked, and slightly reduced in difficulty:
Area 3-2-9 (This Portal Coil), Area 4-2-4 (Gauntlet 4), Area 4-2-8 (Gauntlet 8) and Area 4-2-9 (Gauntlet 9) as there was some frustration with what was deemed unfair level design (and I happened to agree)

There will most likely be another patch coming up within a day to two, to address some minor concerns/bugs. In the meantime thank you so much for the feedback. Have a great day everyone!

notes.title: Release date + preview copies + give aways
notes.notes:
Mark your calendars folks, Blitz Breaker is hitting Steam on [b] February 2, 2016! [/b]

I'm super stoked on this, cause you know, launch time and all that. So, just so you have some info before hand:

- It's going to cost $2.99 US
- The game is going to launch Windows, with mac and linux builds to be added afterwards.
- There will be some key giveaways prior to launch and on launch day via my social accounts, so check out https://twitter.com/blekdar and http://bonchogames.com 

[b] Super important note:[/b] If you or someone you know would like to play + review Blitz Breaker for your Website / Channel / Stream, there's an application link here: https://dodistribute.com/access/QxdLI1txTI/ (keys are limited, keep that in mind please)

Alright, talk to you soon, have a great week!

Cheers,
Reece @ Boncho Games
